summary.text: Alex Padilla has been a U.S. Senator for California since January 2021, when he was appointed to fill the vacancy created by Kamala Harris's election as Vice President; he was elected to a full term in November 2022.

paragraphs.text: He was raised in Pacoima in Los Angeles and earned a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
He served on the Los Angeles City Council from 1999 and as its president from 2001, in the California State Senate from 2006, and was elected California Secretary of State in 2014.
